files.freesoundName: Monastary Bell Toll:  Prinknash Abbey, Gloucestershire
files.description:
The evening bell tolls for Solemn Vespers at 6pm.  The monks ring the bell as part of their ritual.  Only one visitor turned up that evening.  

Birdsong can be heard, crows and an owl.  Cows in the field came up to the recording device as I sat so still enjoying the moment.  You can hear the cows
files.author: kernowrules
